sources.title: OpenCORe
sources.snippet: CORe/OpenCORe is an AI chat platform built around alignment. Also made SiderealCompute. Streaming responses, transparent reasoning, image generation, vision analysis, and multi-model support, designed to be the most aligned AI to date.

sources.title: OpenCore — The Governance Layer for Intelligent Organizations
sources.snippet: Open Initiative — Community Preview The Operating Infrastructure for Autonomous Organizations As AI agents move from assistance to execution, organizations need a structural control layer that ensures alignment, accountability, and controlled execution. OpenCore is an open initiative defining that layer.
